name: 60646 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60646 (Chicago) has 125 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60646 (Chicago) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60646 (Chicago) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
